perks.name: Fragile Focus
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.desc: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Air Assault
perks.desc: Final blows grant a stacking bonus to airborne effectiveness. Final blows while airborne grant increased stacks.

perks.name: Slideways
perks.desc: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability.

perks.name: Slickdraw
perks.desc: Significantly increases handling, significantly decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Encore
perks.desc: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.desc: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

perks.name: Osmosis
perks.desc: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it.

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Offhand Strike
perks.desc: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

perks.name: Field-Tested
perks.desc:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed.

Swords gain increased charge rate and guard resistance.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "It’s interesting this was the Dead Orbit weapon to be brought back to us. Controlling Vision is nowhere near the same levels as Heliocentric. Osmosis and Slideways are not good PvE perks but the alternative is Surplus or…Surrounded? Surrounded is good on a sidearm as you’re going to be in CQC 100% of the time, but Surplus in this economy is just underwhelming. I want to use my abilities, not hold onto them to bump up my sidearm." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Controlling Vision might have had the crucible in mind when being reformed. Fragile Focus, Offhand Strike, Threat Detector, and Encore are all great perks. Slickdraw even bumps up your handling to 100 allowing for better investments into range or stability. The Field Tested origin trait also buffing your weapon while you’re alive is no joke either. This won’t be as good as a kill chaining sidearm, but it could certainly be the longest range adaptive sidearm in the game only really being beaten by Allied Demand but that would be at a higher cost to other stats." Recommended MW: Range.
